title: Nerv Disabled Sidecar
description: Schema for .nerv/disabled.yaml — disabled events and hook×event bindings. Hook-level disable lives on hook entries in hooks.yaml (`disabled: true`); this sidecar handles event-level and binding-level disables. Daemon honours it at dispatch time.

events.description: Globally disabled event names. Every hook bound to any of these events is short-circuited regardless of its own state.

bindings.description: Disabled (hook, event) pairs. Finer granularity than the per-hook flag and per-event list — lets one hook stay live on most events while skipping one.

hook.description: Hook name as it appears in hooks.yaml.

event.description: Event name from the canonical catalog.
